details.description: Mama Mukhwas Digestive mukhvas from house of Mama Mukhwaswala contains dal, variyali, tal, ajma and sava. It has a shelf life of 1 year and is good for digestion. Apart from being a mouth freshener, it also aids digestion. Fennel, which is a very important part of the composition, is known for several health benefits.
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool and dry place

details.description: Mama Mukhwas Shahi special kalkatti pan mukhwas from the house of Mama Mukhwaswala contains betel leaves, fennel seeds, sweet drops, areca nuts, coriander seeds, and cardamom. It has a shelf life of 1 year and no artificial flavours. This is a very popular mouth freshener from the famous city of Kolkata. It has natural ingredients and is a hit among all age groups.
details.ingredients: Betel Leaves, Sweet and Rose Petal Paste, Fennel Seeds, Coriander Pulse, Betel Nuts, Cardamon
details.storageInstructions:
Store in a clean and dry place
Keep away from direct sunlight

details.description: Mama Mukhwas Jaipuri No.1 is a delicious and unique mukhwas product. It is made with a blend of mango and aamchur, offering a tangy and flavourful taste. This mukhwas can be enjoyed as a mouth freshener or a snack. It is a perfect accompaniment to any meal.
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

details.description: Mama Mukhwas Grape vati also known as draksh vati (round balls) is one amazing freshener rooted in the ethos of Ayurveda which aids in digestion and treatment of many diseases. Mama Mukhwaswala combines this magical ingredient with amchur (dry mango powder), kali mirch (black pepper) and sugar to give you the amazing draksha (grape) golis which you can binge anytime!
details.ingredients: Black grapes, dry mango powder, black chilli, sugar

details.description: Mama Mukhwas Dadam (pomegranate) vati (pellets) is a wonderful combination of pomegranate extract and digestive powder in an unconventional and easy to consume form. This classic sweet and sour treat from Mama Mukhwaswala helps preventing cancer and has anti-ageing properties. This is something different and it tastes super healthy.
details.ingredients:
Dadam Churan ,
Mango powder ,
black chilli
sugar
details.storageInstructions:
It can be used as mouth freshener after eating meal .
 It can also be used in salad to give a nutty flavour.
Ready to eat.
Store in clean and dry place.
Keep away from direct sunlight.

details.description: Mama Mukhwas Sweet Amla is a delightful blend of amla (Indian gooseberry) and sugar. Amla is a rich source of vitamin C and antioxidants, making this product a healthy and flavourful snack. Enjoy the sweet and tangy taste of this traditional Indian mukhwas (mouth freshener).

details.description: Mama Mukhwas Imly is a delicious and unique imli (tamarind) flavoured mukhwas (mouth freshener) made with imli and sugar. It is a perfect after-meal treat that helps cleanse the palate and freshen the breath. This mukhwas is a traditional Indian snack that can be enjoyed on its own or as a digestive aid.
